title: Why he joined the union and its gold card
summary: He joined because the union was gaining power, and later received a gold card for thirty years' membership.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: How did you happen to join the union?
Well, it became imperative. The union was getting power. And you joined the union, you're way ahead you know. You're eventually going to do it anyway, so you might as well be ahead.
So that was -- you joined in the end of 1927 and it was in the beginning of 1927 when you started working professionally at the 401.

Right. And I'm glad I did because 30 years later I had my -- I received my gold card from the union, which means you've been in the union 30 years. And the benefits from then -- you pay no more dues and the benefits came later
on for being in the union.
